correctness.rationale: Under point Palm, the three consecutive spacings A,B,C are independent rate-lambda exponentials. Conditioning on B<A and B<C, the density of (B,A-B,C-B) factors into rates (3lambda,lambda,lambda), with probability 1/3. The actual cell lengths are (A+B)/2 and (B+C)/2, hence equal to a common rate-3lambda exponential plus independent rate-2lambda exponentials. Laplace transforms, means, covariance 1/(9lambda^2), variances 13/(36lambda^2), correlation 4/13, diagonal survival, and unconditioned adjacent correlation 1/2 follow by elementary independent-exponential integration. The union of disjoint orientations gives Palm membership probability 2/3, and dividing the joint density 4lambda(exp(-2lambda v)-exp(-3lambda v)) by marginal density 4lambda^2 v exp(-2lambda v) proves the posterior (1-exp(-lambda v))/(lambda v). Its derivative is strictly negative. The packaged seeded 1.6-million-triple per-intensity checker passed independently; sampling is supporting evidence rather than the universal proof.

value.rationale: Mutual nearest-neighbor pairing is a canonical local spatial motif, and genuine adjacent Voronoi cell lengths are the natural allocations of space. Their complete bivariate conditional distribution, explicit reduction in dependence from 1/2 to 4/13, and strictly decreasing conditional point-membership probability given cell length quantitatively connect pair selection, local cellular geometry, and inverse prediction. These objects and mixed quantities have natural motivation independent of arbitrary parameter choices and are not determined by the known individual-cell gamma law or mutual-neighbor proportion. The exact one-dimensional scope is an intended natural complete classification, with no claim in higher dimension.
